name: FlashBlade - replication resume with approval
description: A purefb_replica_link event forwarded by the replication rulebook: a bucket replica link that is paused. Pausing is a human act, so a human approves resuming it; nothing is resumed without that approval, the link's target and credential are untouched, and every outcome is written to the alert log.

nodes.name: Notify: replica link paused, awaiting approval

extra_vars.subject: Replica link ${trigger.event.data.local} -> ${trigger.event.data.remote}:${trigger.event.data.remote_object} on ${trigger.event.array} is paused; a resume awaits approval
extra_vars.detail: ${trigger.event.data.kind} link, direction ${trigger.event.data.direction}, status ${trigger.event.data.status}, recovery point ${trigger.event.data.recovery_point_age_s} s old. Approve or reject in the orchestrator within one hour.

parameters.prompt: Bucket replica link ${trigger.event.data.local} -> ${trigger.event.data.remote}:${trigger.event.data.remote_object} on ${trigger.event.array} is paused (status ${trigger.event.data.status}, recovery point ${trigger.event.data.recovery_point_age_s} s old). Pausing is a human act: approve to resume the link, which clears paused on the link itself and changes nothing else (its target and credential stay as they are). Rejecting leaves the link paused.

extra_vars.reason: approved: link to ${trigger.event.data.remote}:${trigger.event.data.remote_object} paused, status ${trigger.event.data.status}, recovery point ${trigger.event.data.recovery_point_age_s} s old

extra_vars.subject: ${trigger.event.array}: replica link ${trigger.event.data.local} -> ${trigger.event.data.remote}:${trigger.event.data.remote_object} resumed after approval
extra_vars.detail: Resumed: ${replication_resume.artifacts.resumed}; the replication record in the alert log carries the link's status before and the outcome. Job: ${replication_resume.job_url}

extra_vars.subject: Resume of replica link ${trigger.event.data.local} on ${trigger.event.array} rejected or expired; the link stays paused
extra_vars.detail: Link to ${trigger.event.data.remote}:${trigger.event.data.remote_object}, status ${trigger.event.data.status}, recovery point ${trigger.event.data.recovery_point_age_s} s old at the event. The replication rulebook raises the event again once an hour while the link stays paused.
